The Blazor Web App is built and ready. Here's what was created:

**Project structure:**
```
UniversityCourseCatalog/
├── Models/
│   ├── Department.cs
│   ├── Course.cs
│   └── EnrollmentRequest.cs
├── Services/
│   └── CatalogService.cs        # In-memory data for 5 depts, 13 courses
├── Components/
│   ├── Layout/                   # Updated nav with Courses & Enroll links
│   └── Pages/
│       ├── Home.razor            # Featured courses + department cards
│       ├── Courses.razor         # Search + department filter table
│       ├── CourseDetail.razor     # Full details, instructor bio, enroll link
│       └── Enroll.razor          # Standard HTML form with confirmation
└── Program.cs                    # CatalogService registered as singleton
```

**Key decisions:**
- **Static SSR only** (no interactive render mode) — ideal for intranet with fast connectivity
- **Search** filters by title, code, description, and instructor name
- **Enrollment form** uses standard HTML `<form method="post">` with server-side handling
- Course detail pages link directly to the enrollment form with the course pre-selected
- 5 departments (CS, Math, English, Physics, History) with 13 sample courses

Run with `dotnet run` from the project directory.
